spoiler_policy.rule: Mornington may appear: the game's own title card names it as the last-known sighting. No other Case 01 stop (Cape Schanck, Main Ridge, Red Hill), the final venue (Montalto), or any witness tell that resolves them may appear in tile copy, page copy, alt text, or as the subject of a plate a tile renders.
spoiler_policy.why: The first build published the correct route in order across the three-week schedule (Mornington, Cape Schanck, Main Ridge, Red Hill) and reused the 'somewhere with a view' tell as ad copy. Anyone following the account for three weeks would have had the answer before opening the case, defeating the brief's section 13 no-leak criterion from outside the game.
spoiler_policy.fix: Weeks 2 and 3 and the two mechanic tiles now use decoy towns the brief already authors as wrong turns: Sorrento, Flinders and Arthurs Seat. The campaign misdirects exactly as the game does.
spoiler_policy.enforced_by: tools/social-assets/check-where-is-pi.mjs fails on any route name, final venue, witness tell, or route-stop plate reaching a public surface. The previous check tested three hand-written phrases and passed the leak.

downloadable_pack.note: The words ON each creative are parsed out of asset-renderer.html at build time, so the page, the PDF and captions.txt cannot disagree with what the renderer draws. Captions and alt text come from campaign-copy.json; the CTA and prize come from this receipt. Every image in the pack is a review render and carries the watermark; release files come from render-where-is-pi.mjs --release.
